description.value: A boutique hotel situated in the heart of Whistler Village, offering studio suites each equipped with a full kitchen, gas fireplace, and whirlpool bath. The property sits at the corner of Northlands Boulevard and Main Street, putting cyclists within easy walking distance of the village's shops, restaurants, and trail network. An outdoor heated pool and hot tub with mountain views rounds out the on-site amenities.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (16 spaces) at 30m. Total: 16 spaces.

The FAQ confirms free Wi-Fi in all rooms and public areas, corroborating the OSM internet_access=wlan tag. The website contact page confirms the toll-free number (1-888-999-8986), address (4319 Main Street, Whistler, B.C. V8E 1B1), and website URL, all matching the OSM record.
